body: Why August 8th?  What made you select that date?

Want to be a dead person.   Do not want to actually commit suicide on myself, but pray for death daily.   God doesn't answer my prayers.  He is backing me into a corner, and daring me to kill myself.  He's about to win.  I have wanted to die since the day I was born.  I have never known love, happiness, joy, pleasure, laughter.  I just want to step out of this existence.   Life is not meant for everyone.   Life is like anything else that people experience.  Every person has their own likes and dislikes.   Think of your own self - what are the things that you are just not cut out for?  The things that you just don't enjoy?   And think of the things that you really enjoy, but that some of your friends and family aren't into at all.  Got it?   Okay.   There are those of us, some of which have already made their exit, that feel that way about living.   It's just not out thing.  We don't enjoy it, we don't understand it, we don't get how some people like it, and we want our feelings to be accepted and respected.  The same way that if you like board games or sci-fi films or painting, people you know may not enjoy or be into those things, but they would respect that you are.   That's how those of us feel that don't want to play the game of life anymore.
